_purpose: MTM Alerts, Profit Targets, P&L Reporting
_file_role: Tunable parameters ONLY. Secrets (token, chat_id) live in token.env.

quiet_hours._comment: Scheduled P&L reports suppressed outside this window. IMMEDIATE loss alerts always fire regardless.

mtm._comment: Mark-to-market loss alert. Fires IMMEDIATELY with no quiet-hours suppression.

profit_target._comment: Alert when cumulative MTM crosses this profit level.

trailing._comment: Trailing stop thresholds — for alerting/notification purposes only (execution handled by profit_trailing module).

pnl_report._comment: End-of-day P&L summary. Sent once after market close.

retry._comment: Retry behaviour for MTM / balance fetch calls.

alert_format._comment: Control verbosity of Telegram alert messages.
